notes.title: UPDATE 1.10
notes.content:
We received reports about the elevator stopping in Stage 4-4, so we spoke to the building manager and:



 Fixed potential collision bugs with the elevator walls;


 Prevented an error that could stop enemies from entering the elevator properly;
  

 Added a 60-second timer to make the elevator go up to the next floor even if enemies from the previous floor are still alive — this prevents players from getting stuck there.



Blocking and Parrying now have a wider angle! You’ll be able to defend against attacks coming from the front and sides — but not from behind. This is a street fight, so always watch your back!

Grabbing enemies now has greater range. Try tossing them around now!

Enemy voices have been added — now every enemy has something to say!

Fixed some achievements that weren’t unlocking correctly.

Fixed a bug that blocked progress if an enemy was killed with a finisher after a successful parry.

With this update, we’ve fixed all major bugs in Reality Rash!

The game has improved a lot in this launch week, and I’m incredibly grateful for all your feedback.

More updates coming soon!!
